context: Hiroshi-boss gives Yuki year-end formal instructions.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business keigo; ceremonial vocabulary (につきまして/なし/年度/等) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 年度末の処理につきまして、確認しよう。
lines.style: formal boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 書類等は、すでに揃っています。
lines.en: The documents and so on are already gathered.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 不足は、なしということでいいかね?
lines.en: So there are no shortfalls, correct?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、問題なしと確認しました。
lines.en: Yes, I confirmed there are no problems.
lines.style: confident office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新年度につきましても、準備を頼む。
lines.en: Please prepare for the new fiscal year too.
lines.style: formal boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 備品等も、来年度分を手配します。
lines.en: I'll arrange supplies and such for next year.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 御苦労だが、よろしく頼むよ。
lines.en: It's a lot, but I count on you.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm appreciative closing throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 御任せ下さい。漏れなく進めます。
lines.en: Leave it to me. I'll proceed without omissions.
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm sincere closing throughout
